scope.target: Create one reusable original campaign-model casting reference wearing the exact LH-003 shorts before LH-COMMERCE-2 scene execution
scope.view: neutral front-three-quarter and rear-three-quarter casting board
exclusions: Soul identity training before casting approval

acceptance_criteria: The candidate contains one original adult Black woman campaign customer shown as the same identity in front-three-quarter and rear-three-quarter full-body views.
The model reads as confident, professional, contemporary Oakland luxury streetwear rather than a generic catalog mannequin or costume character.
A minimal black fitted top does not obscure the LH-003 waistband, pockets, artwork, side panels, or leg binding.

The exact LH-003 white perforated mesh, rose field, black waistband, angular black panels, red-white binding, directional artwork, and four-pocket topology remain recognizable against the four physical sources.
There are exactly two side pockets and two rear pockets in the garment construction, every visible pocket retains a zipper, and no cargo, patch, open-welt, or extra pocket is invented.
The neutral studio board contains no rose aisle, monument, sculpture, environmental storytelling, or added display text.
The output is candidate-only until independent product-fidelity review and explicit founder casting approval are recorded.
No second paid candidate is submitted automatically if the first candidate fails.

issues.description: LH-COMMERCE-2 has no approved on-model wearer; the missing model must be created as a separate controlled casting candidate before scene generation.
issues.resolution_required: Generate one neutral hash-bound candidate, obtain independent review, then request founder casting approval.

issues.description: The first non-generating Higgsfield enhancement changed vertical side pockets to horizontal, invented a center-back black panel, changed the contracted black top, and failed to distinguish exact product wording from prohibited added display text.
issues.resolution_required: Correct the intent and product context, explicitly bind wearer-left versus wearer-right artwork from eyes-on source review, rerun enhance-only, and require a current prompt-adherence PASS before generation.
issues.latest_observation: The second enhancement corrected pocket orientation and rear geometry but reversed wearer-left and wearer-right artwork; it was rejected before paid generation.
issues.resolution: The third enhancement passed every casting and product assertion and is pinned by SHA-256 for the paid call.

issues.description: The generated model identity, anatomy, pocket topology, styling, and neutral source quality passed, but the Love Hurts treatment changes wearer-relative sides between the front and rear panels.
issues.resolution_required: Do not reuse the quarantined candidate as construction authority. A separate founder decision may approve or reject only the model casting concept before a new explicitly authorized recovery route is designed.

evidence: The four physical product views and four-zipper invariant are already hash-bound.
The casting call is isolated from final scene generation and limited to one paid candidate.
Two enhanced prompts were rejected before paid generation.
The third backend-enhanced prompt passed and is pinned at ccc3c58b44f7b473d4998a47ba1634ba5578aea5a3255451b4c9ce61b3dd0f48.
One 2K candidate was generated for exactly 8.5 credits and bound at 7c911e358d5a5e8c1402873a4cdc604766e7c152006559f98255207ae9bb9fc9.
Independent visual-commerce-qa scored 83.3/100 and rejected the candidate because the garment artwork changes anatomical sides between views.
The model identity, anatomy, professional presence, pocket topology, garment fit, crop, and neutral studio quality passed independently.
The candidate is quarantined and no automatic paid retry, garment-matte production, Comfy staging, scene input, promotion, wiring, or deployment is allowed.
